cases.name: linear-extension
cases.derivation: src/validation.cpp:3224-3259,3274-3282: mined work, known unflagged predecessor, required bits, increasing median and bounded time pass; each unknown header enters the index.

cases.name: empty
cases.derivation: src/validation.cpp:3274-3284: the empty loop accepts and adds nothing; the fixture represents the unchanged output pointer as null.

cases.name: unknown-first
cases.derivation: src/validation.cpp:3224-3231: work passes, then predecessor lookup misses.

cases.name: unknown-middle
cases.derivation: src/validation.cpp:3229-3231,3274-3277: a remains inserted, lookup fails at position 1 and b never runs.

cases.name: nonce-failure
cases.derivation: src/dogecoin.cpp:101-108; src/pow.cpp:127-129; src/validation.cpp:2927-2934,3274-3277: the changed nonce exceeds the target; c never runs.

cases.name: wrong-bits-middle
cases.derivation: src/pow.cpp:54-62; src/validation.cpp:3088-3090,3274-3277: the three-second delay requires limit bits, but the mined candidate uses limit minus one; c never runs.

cases.name: bits-plus-one-middle
cases.derivation: src/pow.cpp:54-69; src/validation.cpp:3088-3090: one-second gaps return the preceding non-limit bits, 0x207ffffe; plus one passes work but fails the raw bits comparison.

cases.name: limit-plus-one
cases.derivation: src/pow.cpp:121-125; src/validation.cpp:2934,3224: 0x20800000 has its sign bit set and zero mantissa, so work fails before contextual checking.

cases.name: duplicate-in-call
cases.derivation: src/validation.cpp:3214-3221: the second a returns its existing entry without checks or insertion; b extends it.

cases.name: duplicate-failed_valid
cases.derivation: src/validation.cpp:3214-3220; src/consensus/validation.h:50-53: either failure flag rejects a known hash with Invalid, zero score and zero code.

cases.name: predecessor-failed_valid
cases.derivation: src/validation.cpp:3233-3234: either predecessor failure flag rejects after work, before the contextual check.

cases.name: duplicate-failed_child
cases.derivation: src/validation.cpp:3214-3220; src/consensus/validation.h:50-53: either failure flag rejects a known hash with Invalid, zero score and zero code.

cases.name: predecessor-failed_child
cases.derivation: src/validation.cpp:3233-3234: either predecessor failure flag rejects after work, before the contextual check.

cases.name: flagged-genesis
cases.derivation: src/validation.cpp:3212,3258-3259,2757-2761: genesis skips duplicate and validation checks; insertion returns the existing flagged entry.

cases.name: genesis-insertion
cases.derivation: src/validation.cpp:3212,3258-3259,2772-2781: genesis bypasses validation and enters at height zero without a predecessor.

cases.name: known-invalid-work
cases.derivation: src/validation.cpp:3214-3221: the known unflagged hash returns before its failing work is checked.

cases.name: known-changed-auxpow
cases.derivation: src/validation.cpp:3209-3221: identical pure bytes give the known key despite a changed parent nonce in the AuxPoW payload; step 2 is skipped.

cases.name: failed-grandparent
cases.derivation: src/validation.cpp:3238-3253: contextual checks pass, a is an ancestor in the failed list, and the walk marks b but excludes a.

cases.name: scripts-valid-bypass
cases.derivation: src/validation.cpp:3241-3256: scripts-valid b skips the failed-list walk, even with a in the list.

cases.name: failed-flag-outside-list
cases.derivation: src/validation.cpp:3233-3234,3241-3256: b has no failure flag and the list is empty; the flag on a alone does not reject c.

cases.name: context-before-failed-ancestor
cases.derivation: src/validation.cpp:3102-3104,3238-3241: median(genesis,a,b) is genesis time plus 3; equality fails before the failed-list walk and leaves all marks unchanged.

cases.name: two-failed-genesis-a
cases.derivation: src/validation.cpp:3242-3253: the first failed ancestor terminates the walk; the listed marks follow fixture visit order. Design 0008 section 8.3 excludes marks from the Core comparison for both orders.

cases.name: two-failed-a-genesis
cases.derivation: src/validation.cpp:3242-3253: the first failed ancestor terminates the walk; the listed marks follow fixture visit order. Design 0008 section 8.3 excludes marks from the Core comparison for both orders.

cases.name: two-branches
cases.derivation: src/validation.cpp:3229,3274-3282: each lookup uses the whole index; branch_child extends branch and b extends the earlier a, not the preceding header.

cases.name: future-time
cases.derivation: src/validation.cpp:3106-3108: candidate time exceeds adjusted_time plus 7200, with passing work, bits and median.

cases.name: short-anchor-view
cases.derivation: Design 0008 sections 5.3 and 7.1; design 0006 section 4, item 16: the height-6 candidate has only one of six required median predecessors. Core has no truncated-chain state. Expected adapter error shortView, not a Core reject.

cases.name: digishield-transition
cases.derivation: src/chainparams.cpp:425-428; src/pow.cpp:49-87; src/dogecoin.cpp:50-86: candidate 10 selects interval one. The three-second spacing gives 1 + trunc((3 - 1)/8) = 1, so target and required bits stay at the limit.

cases.name: auxpow-transition-nonlegacy
cases.derivation: src/chainparams.cpp:430-432; src/validation.cpp:3072-3086: nonlegacy chain-ID version without the AuxPoW flag remains allowed across height 20. Required work remains at the limit with three-second spacing.

cases.name: legacy_19
